# Plugins reference

Plugins add object types, tabs, tasks and API routes. A plugin is active when it is
listed in `plugins.enabled` (or switched on in the console under *Plugins*) **and** the
directory schema defines the object classes it needs. Without `plugins.enabled`, the
core profile is on: `posix`, `ssh`, `sudo`, `mail`, `audit`, `acl_admin`, `ppolicy`.

## access

Access governance: time-bound grants, access requests and access reviews.

## acl_admin

Administration plugin: ACL roles, ACL assignments tab, triggers and the admin API.

## applications

Applications plugin: portal applications and the roles allowed to use them.

## archive

Archive plugin: keep a copy of selected attributes of an object before it is deleted.

## audit

Audit plugin: security audit log of object changes.

## autofs5

Autofs5 plugin: automount maps and entries in LDAP.

## automatic_groups

Automatic groups plugin: keep group memberships in line with a rule.

## calendar_resources

Calendar plugin: calendar resources (rooms and equipment).

## certificates

Certificates plugin: X.509 user certificates (``userCertificate;binary``).

## dhcp

DHCP plugin: ISC DHCP configuration and section tree stored in LDAP.

## dns

DNS plugin: zones, records and reverse zones stored with the ``dNSZone`` schema.

## dsa

DSA plugin: directory service accounts (``simpleSecurityObject``).

## dyngroups

Dynamic groups plugin: the members of a group are computed from a rule.

## extractor

Extractor plugin: export attributes of users as CSV.

## file_sharing

File sharing plugin: storage quota and home folder on user accounts.

## ftp_accounts

FTP plugin: FTP account settings, ratios, bandwidth and quota limits.

## groupware

Groupware plugin: collaboration server service tab on servers.

## imap_mailbox

IMAP mailbox plugin: IMAP/POP3 service tab on servers.

## invitations

Invitations plugin: e-mail personal links to public forms.

## ipam

IPAM plugin: IP address management (VLANs and Subnets).

## ipmi

IPMI plugin: IPMI BMC client tab on servers and workstations.

## kerberos

Kerberos plugin: MIT krb5 principal tab on users.

## ldapmanager

LDIF and CSV import / export tools.

## lifecycle

Lifecycle plugin: act on accounts that reached their end date.

## macro

Macro plugin: telephony macros object type and user macro assignment tab.

## mail

Mail plugin: mail accounts, group mail, and temporary mail aliases.

## mail_protection

Mail protection plugin: user email protection tab.

## mail_store

Mail store plugin: IMAP service tab on servers.

## mail_transport

Mail transport plugin: MTA service tab on servers.

## mixedgroups

Mixed groups plugin: a ``groupOfNames`` that is also a ``posixGroup``.

## netgroups

NIS Netgroup plugin: netgroups (nisNetgroup) and user/system membership tabs.

## notifications

Notifications plugin: mail people when monitored attributes of users change.

## personal

Personal plugin: extra personal information on users (``hrcPersonalInfo``).

## pgp_keys

PGP plugin: PGP keys (``pgpKeyInfo``), key server info, and user tab.

## physical_key

Physical key plugin: badge and hardware key identifiers on users (``hrcPhysicalKey``).

## pki_certificates

PKI plugin: certificates published in the directory by the PKI, referenced by users.

## posix

POSIX plugin: Unix account tab on users and the POSIX group type.

## ppolicy

Password policy plugin (ppolicy overlay).

## public_forms

Public forms plugin: create objects through a token-protected public page.

## quota

Quota plugin: per-filesystem user quotas and server quota service.

## radius

RADIUS plugin: RADIUS account profile tab on users and groups.

## sieve

Sieve plugin: ManageSieve service tab on servers.

## smb_accounts

SMB plugin: SMB domain data for users, POSIX groups and workstations.

## spam_filter

Spam filter plugin: spam filter service on servers and spam settings on users.

## ssh

SSH plugin: OpenSSH public keys of users (``ldapPublicKey``).

## sudo

Sudo plugin: ``sudoRole`` entries (users, hosts, commands and sudoers options).

## systems

Systems plugin: servers, workstations, terminals, printers, network devices, phones.

## user_reminder

User reminder plugin: mail users before their account expires.

## weblink

Web link plugin: web link tab on systems (workstation, server, component, printer).
